content.title: CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 Releasing Shortly at cbse.gov.in;Download Marksheet via Digilocker & UMANG
content.text: CBSE 10th result 2026 will be announced shortly. After the result is announced, students can access their marksheets through Digilocker & UMANG. CBSE 10th 2026 exam was conducted from February 17 to March 11. The Central Board of Secondary Education will announce CBSE 10th result 2026 shortly. CBSE Officials have confirmed that the result uploading process is in full swing. Result link will be activated at cbse.gov.in. A social media post by Digilocker claims that the result is ‘Coming Soon’. It has also advised students to create an account early without waiting for result day. Students can also check and download their marksheets through UMANG. CBSE 10th 2026 exam was conducted from February 17 to March 11.Also Read: CBSE 10th Result 2026 Live Updates The process to check CBSE Class 10 result 2026 via DigiLocker is given below. Go to the DigiLocker website Use your Aadhaar Number or registered mobile number to log in Find Education tab Select Central Board Of Secondary Education Click on Class 10 Marksheet or Passing Certificate Enter your Roll Number and select passing year Submit details Your digital marksheet will appear Download and save it How to Download CBSE 10th Result 2026 via UMANG? The process to download CBSE Class 10 result 2026 via UMANG is given below. Install the UMANG app Register/log in using your mobile number Search for CBSE in search bar or go to the Education category Click on CBSE board option Choose Class 10 Result link Enter your required credentials View your result and download
